learning_rate.description: Shrinkage applied to each boosting round; lower is slower but steadier.

epochs.description: Number of epochs; each adds iters_per_epoch boosting rounds.

max_leaf_nodes.description: Maximum leaves per tree; more leaves fit more detail.

max_depth.description: Maximum tree depth; null means unlimited.

min_samples_leaf.description: Minimum rows per leaf; higher values regularise.

l2_regularization.description: L2 penalty on leaf values; higher values regularise.

early_stopping_patience.description: Stop when validation has not improved for this many epochs; 0 disables.

seed.description: Random seed for the split and the model.
